name: Buttered Noodles
desc: Ruffled pasta tossed hard with good butter, lots of Parmesan and pasta water until glossy.

source.title: Buttered Noodles
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 lb mafaldine or other long pasta
1 tbsp kosher salt, for the pasta water
1 stick (1/2 cup) good butter, such as Vital Farms, cut in pieces
1 cup (about 2 oz) finely grated Parmesan, plus more for serving
1/2 cup reserved pasta water, plus more as needed

steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil with the kosher salt. Cook the pasta until al dente (about 8 min for mafaldine). Reserve 1 cup of the pasta water and drain.
Return the hot pasta to the pot off the heat. Add the butter, a big handful of the Parmesan and 1/2 cup of the pasta water.

Toss and stir hard for 1 to 2 minutes, adding the rest of the Parmesan as you go, until the butter and cheese turn into a creamy, glossy sauce. Add more pasta water a spoonful at a time if it looks greasy or tight.
Finish with the red pepper flakes and more Parmesan.
tips: Vigorous stirring emulsifies the butter and cheese so it clings instead of going greasy.

references.title: Buttered Noodles
references.usedFor: 1 lb mafaldine with 1 stick butter, 8 min cook time, 1/2 cup pasta water to start the sauce
